headline: Uzbekistan Capital Tashkent to Attract $100 Million US Logistics and Commercial Investment
summary: A Tashkent delegation secured agreements for $100 million in foreign investments from US-based ITF Group to develop commercial business infrastructure, hospitality assets, and transport logistics.
why: Uzbekistan's economic reforms aim to attract foreign direct investment into Central Asian transport logistics and real estate assets.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Securing $100 million in foreign direct investment supports infrastructure development.
